title.narrative: Strengthening Parliament’s Role in Malawi’s Development (SPRID)

description.narrative: (Malawi): USAID's Strengthening Parliament's Role in Malawi's Development activity contributes to Malawi's democratic governance by supporting Parliament of Malawi to better fulfill its legislative, oversight, and representative functions. The activity bolsters the effectiveness and independence of Parliament by providing technical support to selected constitutional and standing committees. The activity will provide embedded experts in parliamentary research to help develop a specialized and adequately staffed committee system, able to work through parliament's legislative and oversight functions, to address key public integrity and service delivery. To restore public trust, the activity will provide technical assistance to enhance coordination between parliament and statutory oversight bodies such as the anti-corruption bureau, so they can take timely preventive and corrective action on public accountability issues. The activity will provide technical support to civil society organizations and the media, to help them best utilize the access to information law and build a constructive relationship with Parliament that advances the public interest. By engaging Parliament, civil society and media can ensure that Parliament is responsive and accountable to the public. Parliament in turn can work through civil society and media to leverage public support for their legislative and oversight priorities. The activity aligns with the ICS's Goal 1: Democratic and Accountable Governance; and Objective 1.1 Support Malawian institutions, including parliament, the judiciary, and accountability institutions, to make governance more effective, transparent, and accountable. It also supports USAID/Malawi's 2020 - 2025 Country Development Cooperation Strategy (CDCS) Development Objective 1, which seeks to improve public sector effectiveness and accountability at the national and decentralized levels.
